why_workflow_3_failed: Live Claim Draft for Send required status='approved', an email_approvals row from the last 9 minutes with provider_review, and email_threads.message_version = draft.source_message_version. The inline AI draft never creates the approval and message_version drifts, so every claim returned no row.
